body_text:
First isomorphism theorem for groups. For every homomorphism
$\varphi:G\to H$, the map $g\ker\varphi\mapsto\varphi(g)$ is a
well-defined group isomorphism
$G/\ker\varphi\cong\operatorname{im}\varphi$. The theorem says
that every homomorphic image is obtained by identifying exactly
those elements whose quotient lies in the kernel.
